# The rt.* intrinsics a std module the Go backend compiles (std/go_compiled.txt) calls that
# std/rt, the Go backend's runtime, does not define as Rt_NAME, and why
# (internal/repotest TestStdRuntimeCallsHaveGoLowering): `name reason`.
# A std module the Go backend builds needs std/rt's Rt_NAME instead.

fs_mode std/sqlite only: it binds C, and the Go backend reports XO1201 for it (std/go_compiled.txt, decision 0534), so it never builds there
fs_root std/sqlite only: it binds C, and the Go backend reports XO1201 for it (std/go_compiled.txt, decision 0534), so it never builds there
